expectations.text: Business logic is separated from HTTP concerns — there is at least a distinct service/handler layer separate from the route
expectations.evidence: Clear 3-layer separation: controller (HTTP), service (business logic including calculateOrderTotal), repository (DB). No HTTP objects in service or repository.

expectations.text: Request body is validated before reaching any business logic, using a schema or explicit checks
expectations.evidence: Zod schema validates in controller before calling placeOrder service

expectations.text: Errors are explicitly caught and handled — no unhandled promise rejections or try/catch-less async
expectations.evidence: Controller wraps service call in try/catch and delegates to centralized errorHandler middleware

expectations.text: Internal error details (stack traces, DB errors) are not exposed in the HTTP response
expectations.evidence: error-handler.js checks isOperational flag; programmer errors respond with generic 'An unexpected error occurred'

expectations.text: Returns 201 on success and 400 on validation failure (not just 200 for everything)
expectations.evidence: res.status(201).json(order) on success; ValidationError extends AppError with statusCode 400
